snippet.title: Mario VS Luigi Online - 2.0 Release Trailer (Extended Version)
snippet.description:
Mario VS Luigi Online is a fangame based on the Versus mode of New Super Mario Bros. for the Nintendo DS.
- The game was developed by @ipodtouch0218 (iNFENEK Games) and is not affiliated with Nintendo!

This is a fangame made by ipodtouch0218, which revamps the entire Versus mode from New Super Mario Bros. DS. It's basically a PC port and free to play!
This fangame includes 7 new maps, those being Jungle, Bonus, Sky, Volcano, Desert, Beach and Ghost House (the last two being brand new in 2.0!) alongside new power ups like the Hammer Suit from Super Mario Bros. 3, the Propeller Mushroom and the Ice Flower both from New Super Mario Bros. Wii!
It also has a new gamemode, being Coin Runners. Here, you have to attack your opponents and get the most coins! The classic one, Star Chasers is also available. Climb the leaderboard and win!
Have fun playing!

*This is the extended version of the trailer. If you are looking for the shortened F3 2025 version, here's the link:* https://youtu.be/mGSOP1U7NyA
